description: Switch which verified Google Search Console website property is tracked in Results and results_get (Studio and Pro). Use a siteUrl listed by search_console_status.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

siteUrl.description: One of the verified Google Search Console site addresses from search_console_status, such as "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://example.com/".

name: search_console_select
title: Choose Google Search Console site
